reverseCardsDescription: In this mode, you’ll see the word in your native language and try to recall the translation in the target language. It helps reinforce your active vocabulary.
cardsDescription: Each card shows a word – tap to reveal the translation and memorize it.
matchingDescription: Drag or tap to connect each word with its correct meaning.
profileSettingsDescription: Set interface and learning languages according to your needs
interfaceLanguageDescription: The language in which the app interface will be displayed
learningLanguageDescription: The language you want to learn or improve
chooseGoals: Choose one or several goals to personalize learning
changePasswordDescription: Change your password and confirm your email
confirmationNote: We will send a confirmation email to your address
